title: DevForge release identity
description: RELEASE-IDENTITY.json at the release root (installed-layout contract v2, corrective-spec-002 CS-6.3). Binds the installed release to its DevForge commit and tag and to the exact DevForgeAI candidate it was built from. It never carries the digest of RELEASE.sha256, which lists it.

version.description: the release version; equals the record's protected_release.version

devforge_commit.description: the DevForge commit that carries the built tree; equals protected_release.source_commit

candidate_repository.description: the DevForgeAI repository the candidate was reviewed in

candidate_checkpoint_id.description: the checkpoint whose staged candidate this release was built from; that record's enforcement.candidate must equal the two fields below

candidate_manifest_sha256.description: digest of the promoted candidate manifest, which is the installed contracts/MANIFEST.sha256; equals enforcement.candidate.manifest_sha256

launcher_toolchain.description: the rustc identity that built bin/devforge (BUILD-DIGEST.txt)
